PERFECT FOR FANS OF SARAH J. MAAS AND JENNIFER L. ARMENTROUT

'Read this series NOW! I felt like I was in the story watching and holding my breath the entire time' 5***** Reader Review
'Sexy and touching all at the same time . . . and that plot twist, OMG' 5***** Reader Review
_______

Locked inside a new kingdom, with no allies of my own, something has been set free inside me.

Something dark. Something angry.

It is my anger that calls out to him: King Ravinger.

Sinister, powerful and entirely too seductive, his danger is only outweighed by my unrelenting attraction.

But I won't be caught in a cage again.

No, this time, it'll be me setting the trap . . .
_______

'A spectacularly written, engaging, imaginative retelling of the ancient myth of King Midas' 5***** Reader Review

'I literally devoured this book in one sitting' 5***** Reader Review

Sunday Times bestseller April 2023
